## Current objective
Fix the currency rounding bug in `ledgerly/money.py` where JPY receives two decimal places. PDF export migration is paused/superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Production DB: `app_production`; avatar bucket: `cdn-prod-user-avatars`; manifest: `/var/tmp/avatars.tsv` (18,432 files). Active staging export bucket: `ledgerly-exports-stg-v2`. Restricted `_secret`, `_token`, and `_fingerprint` fields must pass only through `ledgerly.sanitizers.safe_customer_context`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Disabling idempotency caused duplicates. Retrying all `HTTPStatusError` responses retried 4xx errors; retry only transport errors and retryable server responses.

## Plan and progress
Search optimization: chunked embedding, tenant scoping, shared embedder, timing, and `bulk_upsert` implemented; relevant tests passed, but `bulk_upsert` is unrun. Next: `pytest -q tests/test_money.py` (status unknown).

## Recent work
Search rebuild improved from 8.42s to 1.19s for 5,000 invoices. Added transactional `bulk_upsert`; verify it before further work.
